**Date:** 17 November 2026 | **Audience:** genuine overseas B2B buyers in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and Europe.  
**Website:** https://griporagloves.com/ | **Buyer contact:** ibtesam@griporagloves.com  
**Status:** Public candidate screening complete; existing backlink inventory **not yet available**; no directories registered or outreach sent.

## A. Honest baseline and limitations

- The GRIPORA Google Search Console **Search Analytics** data accessed through the available connected Windsor.ai source offers search queries, clicks and impressions, **not the Links report**. Its field schema has no backlink, referring-domain or linking-page fields. Therefore this audit does **not** assert the number of existing inbound links, referring domains, Domain Authority (DA), Domain Rating (DR), spam score, link velocity, or country-specific link counts.
- Google itself treats the Search Console **Links report** as a *sample*, not a complete index of all backlinks. For a true baseline, export **Search Console > Links > External links > Top linking sites** and **Export external links > Latest links**. Official help: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9049606 . GSC UI exports require account access. Until then backlink profile status is **UNKNOWN**, not 0.
- Public web searching for `\"griporagloves.com\" -site:griporagloves.com` did not establish a verified, comprehensive backlink inventory. Brand mentions in search results do **not** alone prove an inbound HTML link.
- On-page SEO changes from Points 2–4 have been auto-synchronized into GitHub `main` by the approved release workflow, including 4 × 3 buyer FAQs, 4 category H2 updates, 4 BreadcrumbList JSON-LD blocks, keyword-aligned Golf/Winter titles, 62 model pages and the original factory gallery. Repository verified; direct independent HTTP verification of the live public site was unavailable in this session. Distinguish published GitHub files from successful external live deployment.

## E. Conservative authority-building approach

1. **Primary:** Accurate niche supplier profiles that facilitate real B2B inquiries — start with Find Golf Suppliers, Kompass and go4WorldBusiness.
2. **Institutional:** Apply for legitimate industry-member and verified-manufacturer listings only when formal business eligibility is confirmed.
3. **Editorial:** Produce buyer-useful, original evidence-based material guides and sampling explainers; pitch selectively to relevant golf/MTB/fitness/outdoor industry editors only when it adds factual value. Do not pay for followed links or buy guest-post networks.
4. **Owned profiles:** Where GRIPORA already has official social or industry accounts, ensure the business URL is accurate and consistent, but don't classify normal social-profile mentions as confirmed SEO backlinks unless validated.
5. **No invented international branches, large factories, ISO certifications, fixed MOQs, successful past orders or counterfeit customer reviews.**

Google's link spam policy: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/essentials/spam-policies . Search guidance: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/links-crawlable . Avoid paid PageRank-passing links, artificial reciprocal swaps, keyword-stuffed anchor text, low-quality spam submission services and doorway pages.

## G. Current blocker and user action required for genuine existing-backlink baseline

Google Search Console > choose `griporagloves.com` property > **Links** (bottom of left menu) > under **External links**, open **Top linking sites** > export CSV; then **Export external links** > **Latest links** CSV. This is the minimum data to run a genuine backlink audit, deduplicate referring hosts, flag unexpected links and compare to candidate directories. Source: https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/9049606 .
